note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file). Rehearse deploy then remove once so the recorded run is a real first run (the column stays after remove: update the narration if the line says it exists).
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
Push-Location formscript; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; npm test; Pop-Location
manual_prepare: Form Information (main): add Request Code, Customer Account, Budget, Due Date, Priority and Business Justification to the first section, save, publish (Business Justification exists only after the first deploy).
Business rule 'Justification for large budgets' (scope Entity, Budget >= 50000, Set Business Required, nested Show Error Message, false branch Not Business Required): validate, save, activate.
PR-0004: Budget 75,000, Customer Account Contoso Ltd, empty justification; PR-0011 and PR-0013 also Contoso Ltd.

screens.name: form-designer
steps: Open the main form 'Information' (modern form designer)
Show the section with Name, Request Code, Customer Account, Budget, Due Date, Priority, Business Justification
Open the Events tab or tree view (optional)
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: business-rule
steps: Select DEV, Solutions, MGLabDataverse, Tables, Project Request, Business rules
Show Scope = Entity (top right), the condition Budget >= 50000, Set Business Required and the nested Show Error Message on the true branch, Not Business Required on the false branch
Use zoom / mini-map so the whole rule fits; status Active
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: app-form
steps: Select DEV, Apps, open the model-driven app with Project Request
Open PR-0004 after a hard refresh (Ctrl+F5) so the new script loads
In one frame: yellow notification 'Contoso Ltd already has N open requests', Request Code locked, Budget 75,000, Business Justification required with the rule's message
Optional: change Customer Account to one with no other requests (warning disappears); Budget 40,000 (asterisk goes); a new record has an editable Request Code
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real account names (fictional Contoso only)

teardown: Push-Location src; python -m custkit remove; Pop-Location
manual_teardown: Deactivate and delete the business rule (so episode 1's import works again).
Remove Business Justification from the form and publish; keep the column if episode 4 is next.
